goal: Create a network scanning tool that can scan ports, resolve hosts, and provide detailed network information
acceptance_criteria: Script must accept IP address or hostname for scanning
Script must support port range specification
Script must handle CIDR notation in host specification
Script must provide JSON output format
Script must have proper error handling for socket operations
Script must include input validation for ports and hosts
All functions must be properly exported and accessible
Comprehensive test suite must pass with proper socket handling and DNS resolution
